comments: 3d6617b2: ;Sets variables and kills arrays.
08026bf9: ;Sets DIE, DIC, DP, DL, DIEL, DU variables and kills DG, DE, DB arrays.
3a1bc830: ;If visit date exists, store visit date in DE(1).
8fd1c225: ;Kills %Z.
63076744: ;Writes out header label.
b35bd3ad: ;Quits.
b8a9836d: ;Outputs value of Y and wraps if longer than 45 characters.
84452af6: ;If value of Y is longer than 19 characters, not DV, or DV is F or K, goes to RW^DIR2.

99a5b375: Display message indicating that no editing is allowed if the data is invalid or if the file has the 'I' (Input transform) flag set and there are an odd number of entries in the DE array for that field.
b12fc567: Read input from the user with a timeout and store it in X. If the user times out, set X to the up-arrow character and set the DTOUT flag. Also beep the terminal.
ca25d69b: Exit the current routine or subroutine.
0f0ba092: Kill the current field entry in the DQ array and increment DQ to move to the next field.
c66a4333: Branch to the label indicated by the current value of DQ (which is a field number).
fc219b8a: If the DE array has an entry for the current field DQ, go to the label PR. Otherwise, execute the W and TR routines or subroutines.
ba2b8d3f: If the user entered nothing, branch based on the following conditions: If DV does not contain 'R' (Required), go to A; If DV is null, go to X; If D is negative, go to X; Otherwise, go to A.
e31398bf: Exit if the user enters '?' or if the string begins with '^' and go to D^DIE17.
9e22718d: If the user enters '@', call D^DIE2 and go to Z^DIE2.

123c5c3c: If the user enters a space, DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and there is a value stored in ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB), then set X to that value. If DV does not contain 'D' or 'S', write the value of X.

ba7a2548: If DV contains 'V', go to DIE3. If DV does not contain 'S', go to P. If ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) exists, execute it. Set % to the value after ';_X_:' in ';_DU'. Set Y to X. If % is not empty and DIC("S") exists, execute DIC("S"). If DB(DQ) does not exist, write the value of %. Then go to V.
bd22341e: Quit if the slash and piece indicator is located.
205eab82: Write the remainder of the input if the current node does not have descendants, and move the input pointer to the next piece.
5457aa73: If the field type indicates a pointer, set up and call the DIC lookup utility. If the user enters an up-arrow, quit.
1a03536b: If the value contains a decimal point with more than 24 digits after it, invalidate the response and go to the restart code.

4be839e4: If the user input is a number with a decimal point, format it by removing leading zeros, removing trailing zeros after the decimal point, and converting to an integer if there is no decimal portion.
2cd78eb9: ;Kill variable YSYS and terminate recursion
8c202b77: ;Allow user to change Output Root if valid; Store previous value if .01 field
9d650903: ;Write bell and escape if field has Input Transform
24e6e2ad: ;If DB array does not exist assume input is invalid
19dccfa4: ;Branch to Quit Code
891fd10d: ;Set DQ(DQ) to description of field definition
98653814: ;If DE(DQ) does not exist, O evaluates XECUTABLE HELP PROMPT; RD if user enters nulls or uparrows; A if R//; else set X=Y and allow looping with N
d2418d68: Execute saved code from the data dictionary if present.
f751cd17: If global contains piece, use it as IEN to navigate global and get the field number and input transform. Use field #.01 properties for next iteration.
521be16a: If input is a variable pointer, use the pointer and handle as in first case. Otherwise, use the value as IEN, navigate global, get field number and input transform for next iteration.
1fa566c3: Replace the default string value with the value between the current piece separator and the next colon if it exists.
204ad58e: ;If DV is invalid or a reset value, quit or go to 'A' label.
37c29685: ;If DV is not an input transform, go to RD label.
514444dc: ;Perform input transform on X. If X is defined, go to RD label. Otherwise, go to PR label.
c516cff8: ;Quit.
34c7223c: ;Initialize variables for DGJXA10 input template.
75898049: ;Set variables for field 10.02 (DICTATED BY).
044a4dd2: ;Set prefix for VA(200, global reference.
399e7e10: ;Go to RE label.
5b882d2c: ;Quit X1 label.

5686783f: ;If DG is defined, execute F^DIE17 and DE commands. Set Y to up-arrow, DQ to 2. Execute X2 label. If Y is undefined or up-arrow, go to A label. Set X to Y, DIC(0) to 'F', DW to DQ value. Go to OUT^DIE17 label.
83b83a70: If there is no text in X then set the .01 field of the DT multiple to null, set the DGJTST variable to 'INCOMPLETE', and set Y to the string '@2'.
f5a505c7: Quit the current execution.

26b42410: If the DG array is defined (indicating input transformation), call the FileMan EN^DIE17 routine, set Y to the up-arrow character, set DQ to 3, call the X3 label, if Y is undefined or an up-arrow, go to label A. Otherwise, set X to Y, set DIC(0) to 'F' (indicating a field is being edited), set DW to the value of DQ, and go to the OUT^DIE17 routine.
a63cb288: Set the DGJTST variable to 'DICTATED'.
3541c2f2: Quit the current execution.
389323f7: If the DG array is defined (indicating input transformation), call the FileMan EN^DIE17 routine, then go to the ^DGJXA11 routine.
